title: Keep a corpus fresh, and prove it matters

exports.name: content_digest
exports.description: Stable digest of a document's content, used to decide whether a re-fetched document actually changed.

exports.name: detect_changes
exports.description: Compare two corpus snapshots by digest and report which documents were added, changed, removed, and unchanged.

exports.name: plan_reconversion
exports.signature: plan_reconversion(changes: dict, cost_per_page: float, budget: float) -> dict
exports.description: Choose which changed documents to re-convert within a cost budget, and name what was left out and why.

exports.name: replay_scores
exports.description: Score a replayed question set against a corpus snapshot, recording for each question whether its supporting document was present at all.

exports.name: staleness_report
exports.description: Compare replay scores across two corpus snapshots, separating questions whose score moved from questions whose supporting document moved.
